segment: Residential price/value switchers currently on a competitor

research_questions.question: What is each competitor's actual serviceable footprint and advertised speed tiers in Ocala/Marion County specifically?
What are current standalone and bundled pricing tiers, promo rates, and post-promo rates for each competitor?
What early-termination fees, equipment/rental fees, and other recurring surcharges does each competitor charge?
What documented triggers cause residential customers to switch ISPs (promo-cliff bill shock, reliability, customer service, moving)?
How much does a bundled mobile plan influence purchase decisions for price/value switchers specifically?
What do verified customer reviews/complaints say about each competitor's pain points, prioritizing Ocala/central-FL sources?
How have other regional fiber ISPs without a mobile bundle positioned and priced against national cable/wireless incumbents?
What marketing channels are effective and cost-appropriate for a low-brand-recognition regional ISP in a mid-size FL market?

assumptions_and_gaps: Company_name parameter limited to Wire3 and the named competitors per instructions; therefore RQ7 (other regional fiber ISPs) will be researched primarily via Wire3 as an exemplar and via competitors' public positioning—we cannot directly call other regional ISP company_overview endpoints.

Local, address-level serviceability data may not be publicly available; competitor_discovery and product_portfolio_mapping will rely on advertised coverage maps and third-party aggregators rather than guaranteed per-address provisioning.

Pricing, promos, and fees can vary by ZIP/parcel and change frequently; pricing_research will capture advertised/published local offers and documented promo terms but may not reflect every door- or ZIP-specific promotion.

Some desired evidence sources in the brief (e.g., J.D. Power, Parks Associates, FCC datasets) may have paywalls or dataset access constraints; planned calls will use publicly accessible summaries and articles where full datasets are unavailable.

Wire3 is assumed to have limited public-facing pricing and brand presence; calls for Wire3 may yield sparse direct data and will therefore focus on available product/pricing statements and local news.

Verified customer complaints and local sentiment (RQ6) may require combing local forums, BBB, Trustpilot and Reddit; competitor_discovery and recent_news calls are scoped to surface representative local/central-FL signals but cannot guarantee exhaustive capture of all user posts.

Influence of mobile bundle on switch decisions (RQ5) is context-dependent and often studied by industry reports; within tool constraints, recent_news and competitor_discovery will target public reports and articles mentioning bundle influence but may not find rigorous survey data specific to Ocala.
We will not access or use any paywalled, competitor non-public, or Wire3 internal data per the brief exclusions.
Time and cost budget copied exactly from the brief; planned calls (16) are well within the max_search_calls limit (40) and intended to fit within the wall-clock and cost constraints.
